title: Homework: kinetic energy practice sheet, questions 1 to 8
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Making materials (9E); conservation of energy
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 21 (Complete the kinetic energy practice sheet (portal worksheet), questions 1 to 8.)
intro: Kinetic energy (J) = ½ × mass (kg) × speed² (m/s)². Write the formula, substitute, then calculate with the unit.

questions.q: A 2 kg ball moves at 3 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy.
A 10 kg trolley moves at 4 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy.
A 0.5 kg ball is thrown at 10 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy.
A 1,200 kg car travels at 10 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy in kJ.
A 60 kg runner moves at 5 m/s. Calculate the runner's kinetic energy.
A 0.06 kg tennis ball moves at 20 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy.
The 2 kg ball from question 1 now moves at 6 m/s. Calculate its kinetic energy. What happens to the kinetic energy when the speed doubles?
questions.a: ½ × 2 × 6² = 36 J; doubling the speed multiplies the kinetic energy by 4

questions.q: A 4 kg object has 200 J of kinetic energy. Calculate its speed.
questions.a: 200 = ½ × 4 × v², so v² = 100 and v = 10 m/s
